settings.title: Oral absorption. Not gut absorption.
settings.body: Traditional sports drinks hit your stomach first - then wait 30-60 minutes. ElectroChew absorbs directly through the mucous membranes in your mouth, bypassing the digestive system entirely. Electrolytes reach your bloodstream in 5-10 minutes. The science is called buccal and sublingual absorption - and it changes everything.
